text_block_list.text: "Let's rethink the Grand Live one more time."
I called out to the Umamusume who had offered to help so far, and we decided to gather together, but—

text_block_list.name: Cooperating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...It seems my friend won't be able to make it today.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Thank you for letting me know.
choice_data_list: Shall we get right down to business?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The reason I called you all here today
is for none other than this.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "I was thinking of revisiting the core concept of the Grand Live once more."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I thought of the Grand Live as a concert
where all the Umamusume students could express their gratitude.
However—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I felt this was a concert where we could do something important, different from a Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Cooperating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What's important...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We don't know that yet, though...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa!
You started talking without me?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hello. You're keeping a secret
from everyone, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh... What is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's about your past.
About how you were once a backup dancer—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone told me about that
while you were away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, no way! I went out of my way to cut a deal with Shakur just to get that info, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, come on...
So you heard the stuff about "senpai" too, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's with that look?
Oho? Oho-ho-ho?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Say, Hello-kun?
You had a certain 'senior,' didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just like you, there was an Umamusume who retired
without ever becoming the center.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was shining with all my might, right?
Even if I was just a backup dancer like always...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
"The people who support me will cheer for me no matter where I am.
That's why I want to give it my all to repay them, anytime, anywhere."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win, and sing my song of gratitude...!
Today of all days, I wanted them to hear it...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Senior
text_block_list.text: And yet, why am I—!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. There was.
She was a truly wonderful senior.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then what did you think
of that senior?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Of course I wanted to stand in the center. But... back then...
...I just wasn't good enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! What a magnificent ego!
Yes, yes, just as I expected of you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, you are truly magnificent! Quite distinct from Suzuka-kun!
A fitting specimen of a fan!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A fan...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Hello-san. What does
the Grand Live mean to you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: To me... well, um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, not as an Umamusume, but as a fan—I'd really love to hear your answer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I finally understand.
What a Live means differs depending on the person,
and their position."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Until now, I had always thought that the live performance was a place to express gratitude for the race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I figured as long as I expressed my gratitude, it would be enough.
That as long as I put on a performance, it would be enough...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But I was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because for me, that place was where
the fans welcomed me back with a 'Welcome home.'

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What a concert means is different for everyone.
Surely, that's true for both us and the fans—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second, please.
I haven't been able to wrap my head around what you've been saying!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: As for me, umm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...You were a fan who just wanted
to watch someone's stage, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um, was I mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
“...... No, not at all.
...I see, so I'm...”

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(...Please. If there truly is a God...
Please let my senior's tears be rewarded.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(Because I know Senpai's live performance
is going to be wonderful—)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted
to see your stage, Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...What? Have you only just realized where you stand?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh well. The greatest experiment is yet to come!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"What I seek is purely empirical proof
of the 'potential' brought about by live performances."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Instead of surpassing limits, we expand the limit itself. For us who continue to reach for the uncharted realm no one has ever reached, this is an investment in the future!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If you try to reach the realm beyond that on your own, you might surpass your "limits."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we resume the experiment?!

What does the "Grand Live" mean,
not just for Umamusume, but for the fans?
We ended up exploring that side of things—
